name: T.E.D.D. Tasks
description: Black Ops 7's timed tasks at the terminal (TASKS.EXE): from round 9, then every 4-6 rounds, T.E.D.D. offers a 2-minute task (500 points, +500 every 10 rounds). Bronze to Legendary ratings pay out a loot chest at the terminal; weapons come from your own Mystery Box list, a free perk only at Legendary.
